response.original_title: [ Step-by-Step Guide] How Do I Add a Passenger to My Crystal Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Crystal Cruise booking 1-866-254-7549, you must call Crystal Cruises Customer Service directly or contact your travel agent 1-866-254-7549, as passenger additions cannot be processed online or through the mobile app.How to Request an Addition Call Customer Service: Dial 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK). Contact Your Travel Agent: If you booked through a personal travel advisor 1-866-254-7549, reach out to them directly to manage the update. Have Details Ready: Provide your existing reservation number 1-866-254-7549, along with the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and payment information.
